name: cipher-marketing-remotion
description: Remotion compositing for CipherExam ad videos. Stitches AI-generated clips, burns captions, persists logo, renders end-card.

scripts.render:compressed: remotion render src/index.ts CipherExamAd out/raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/raw.mp4 -crf 23 -preset slow out/cipherexam-ad.mp4
scripts.motion:all: npm run motion:pmp && npm run motion:secplus && npm run motion:shrmcp
